title: Parents, Daughter Accused of Stealing Cosmetics From Laredo Store
excerpt: Three adults from one family were arrested after police said they worked together to steal more than $370 in cosmetics from a Laredo store on Nov. 22.
content:
Three adults from one family were arrested after Laredo police said they worked together to steal more than $370 in cosmetics from a Laredo store, according to KGNS.

Officers were called about 1:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 22, to a store in the 7500 block of San Dario Avenue, police said. Security video allegedly showed 21-year-old Valentina Gamboa-Vasquez and a 14-year-old girl hiding the cosmetics, and the parents, 50-year-old Francisco David Gamboa and 45-year-old Nayeli Vasquez-Acevedo, allegedly kept watch.

Police said the group later met at another location of the same store. Officers found the parents in a silver Volkswagen in the parking lot and arrested them; the 21-year-old was also arrested, and the 14-year-old was detained, according to Local National.

The three adults were booked into the Webb County Jail on charges of organized retail theft of property valued between $100 and $750, a Class A misdemeanor, according to jail records.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 24, 2026; Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 24, 2026; Local National, Nov. 24, 2026.
